scope: Actual cold Model ObjectStroke -> Drawing DrawObject -> GLV1/RTV1 material route. Source-input CPU model profile. Sparse native P4 snapshots are expected outputs only.

target.model_canvas_initial: transparent from DrawObject clear=1; queue-10-before readback was all-zero validation witness

draw_state.layout: shared 16-f32 projection; 15 P4 records of model16+depthScale2; 3 P3 records of projection16+model16+depthScale2+blendRatio1

expected_only.layout: SDOCXOV2 magic, u32 LE width/height, u16 prefix count; each prefix: u32 record count, records of u32 linear bottom-up index + RGBA8

shared_inputs: Reuse unchanged V23 geometry, P3 VBO, mask and depth red-lane extracts; native textures are RGBA8, not R8.

host_model.sampler: F32 UV to rounded 8-fraction-bit fixed coordinate; integer bilinear interpolation; normalized byte to F32 then F16 RTZ then F32.
host_model.blend: P4 ONE/INV_SRC_ALPHA: quantize source toRGBA8 then normalized integer destination product and saturated add. P3 remains shader overwrite.
host_model.rounding_limit: CVTPS2DQ uses MXCSR; RN-even assumed, live control bits not captured.
host_model.blend_proof_limit: Pinned common Mesa source plus separate Crayon2 activeIR; Oil-specific active blendIR not captured.

limitations: synthetic constructed ObjectStroke on host Mesa profile, not Notes parser/device/export path
same source math and shader hashes do not prove host context/renderer portability
P3 feedback is regenerated by the Rust source model; no captured post-P3 texture pixels are used as model input
new profile changes page dimensions and actual per-draw state/depthScale; V23 state/192x192 expected prefixes remain untouched
